purpose: Bounded manual ACM Digital Library supplement for Engineering Reliable Coding Agents. Automated agents are excluded by the ACM Digital Library end-user policy.
collection: ACM Full-Text Collection, not the broader Guide to Computing Literature
retention_boundary: Retain the executed query, filters, date, result count, and citation identifiers exported through the user interface. Do not bulk-download or redistribute ACM full text.

topics.query: ("systematic literature review" OR "systematic mapping study" OR "multivocal literature review" OR "grey literature") AND "software engineering"
("coding agent" OR "program repair" OR "code generation") AND (benchmark OR evaluation OR contamination OR oracle)
("automated evaluation" OR "human evaluation" OR "inter-rater agreement") AND (software OR code)
("code review" OR "pull request review") AND ("artificial intelligence" OR automation OR human)
(agent OR automation) AND ("fault injection" OR recovery OR reliability OR idempotent)
("code search" OR "repository retrieval" OR "issue localization") AND (context OR developer)
("multi-agent" OR "multi agent") AND ("software engineering" OR programming) AND (coordination OR delegation)
("generative AI" OR "artificial intelligence") AND ("software engineering" OR programming) AND (adoption OR governance OR accountability)

venues.publication_filter: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
International Conference on Software Engineering proceedings
Foundations of Software Engineering or ESEC/FSE proceedings
International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis proceedings
Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction, CSCW issues
